howToChange: WS2 adds entries inside R500-R599 as T0 changes (contracts/diagnostics.md). Codes never change meaning; runtime/core/include/errors.h carries the same numbers and the core builds its messages from these templates ({name} placeholders). Messages follow the C9 voice and banned-word list.

entries.title: Variable never given a value
entries.message: {name} was never given a value in {object}
entries.hint: Give it a value first, for example in the Create event.

entries.title: Global never given a value
entries.message: global.{name} was never given a value
entries.hint: Set global.{name} before reading it, for example in the first room's Create event.

entries.title: Instance not found
entries.message: There is no instance {id} (it was destroyed, or never existed)
entries.hint: Check instance_exists(id) before using an instance you stored.

entries.title: No instance of that object
entries.message: There is no {object} in the room to read {name} from
entries.hint: Check instance_number({object}) > 0 first.

entries.title: Too many extra variables
entries.message: {object} got more than 8 variables from outside its own code
entries.hint: Give the variable a value in the object's Create event, so it gets its own slot.

entries.title: Read-only variable
entries.message: {name} can't be changed

entries.title: Script never finished
entries.message: {object} / {event} never finished: a loop there seems to run forever
entries.hint: Check that every loop's condition can become false.

entries.title: Too many calls inside each other
entries.message: Too many functions were called inside each other in {event}
entries.hint: Check that a function that calls itself stops at some point.

entries.title: Whole number too big
entries.message: A whole number got too big (past +-2147483647)
entries.hint: Keep numbers smaller, or divide before you multiply.

entries.title: Number with a fraction too big
entries.message: A number with a fraction got too big (past +-524287.99)
entries.hint: Numbers with a fraction must stay between -524288 and 524288 on the DS.

entries.title: Division by zero
entries.message: Can't divide by zero
entries.hint: Check the number you divide by before dividing.

entries.title: Square root of a negative number
entries.message: Can't take the square root of a negative number ({value})
entries.hint: Use abs() first, or check that the number is 0 or more.

entries.title: Values that don't go together
entries.message: Can't {action} {left} and {right}
entries.hint: Use string(n) to turn a number into text before joining it to text.

entries.title: Values that can't be compared
entries.message: Can't compare {left} with {right} using {op}
entries.hint: Only numbers with numbers, or text with text, can be put in order.

entries.title: Wrong kind of value for a function
entries.message: {function} needs {expected} here, but got {actual}

entries.title: List position out of range
entries.message: Position {index} is outside the list (it has {length} items)
entries.hint: List positions start at 0 and stop at the length minus 1.

entries.title: Not a list
entries.message: Can't use {what} on {kind}: it is not a list
entries.hint: Make it a list first, for example a = [] or a[0] = 1.

entries.title: Out of memory for text and lists
entries.message: The game ran out of memory for text and lists
entries.hint: Keep fewer long texts and big lists around at once.

entries.title: Too many instances
entries.message: There are too many instances at once (the most is 512)
entries.hint: Destroy instances that left the screen, for example in their Outside Room event.

entries.title: Picture could not be loaded
entries.message: {asset} could not be loaded
entries.hint: Build the game again; if it keeps happening, the room uses more sprite memory than the DS has.

entries.title: Sound could not be loaded
entries.message: {asset} could not be loaded
entries.hint: Build the game again; if it keeps happening, the room's sounds need more memory than the DS has.

entries.title: Asset not loaded in this room
entries.message: {asset} is not loaded in {room}
entries.hint: Use it in a room that places an object using it, or reference it from an object placed in {room}.

entries.title: Damaged game file
entries.message: The game file is damaged ({detail})
entries.hint: Build the game again.

entries.title: Built for a different runtime
entries.message: This ROM was built for a different DSDude runtime
entries.hint: Build the game again with this version of DSDude.

entries.title: Feature not in this runtime
entries.message: This game uses something this DSDude runtime can't do yet ({detail})
entries.hint: Update DSDude, or avoid {detail} for now.

entries.title: Game too big
entries.message: The game is too big for the DS ({detail})
entries.hint: Make the game smaller: fewer or shorter scripts, rooms or globals.

entries.title: Game file missing
entries.message: The game file could not be read ({detail})
entries.hint: Build the game again; if it keeps happening, the ROM is damaged.

entries.title: Assertion failed
entries.message: Assertion failed: {message}
